author: nself
description: Traefik reverse proxy from the nSelf route model: file-provider configuration rendered from routes.json at route, TLS and upstream parity with nginx. No Docker socket, certificates from core.

envVars.description: Comma-separated route ids also served on the upload entrypoint (container port 8444); default empty (no upload entrypoint). Restart the stack after changing.
envVars.name: TRAEFIK_UPLOAD_ROUTES

envVars.description: readTimeout of the upload entrypoint, whole seconds from 60s to 24h; default 600s. Only used when TRAEFIK_UPLOAD_ROUTES is set.
envVars.name: TRAEFIK_UPLOAD_READ_TIMEOUT

envVars.description: Host side of the upload port mapping; default 127.0.0.1: (loopback ephemeral port, nothing public). Set 8444 to expose it.
envVars.name: TRAEFIK_UPLOAD_PUBLISH

name: traefik
